title: feat: reduce-first yuv pass and its device cost

commit.merge_subject: merge: feat: reduce-first yuv pass and its device cost

description: E0b-4a. The GPU YUV pass gains 'reduce first, then process': with N > 1 each output pixel's Y is the integer-rounded mean of its N x N luma block and each 2x2 pixel group's CbCr the rounded mean of the N x N chroma block (edge blocks average what exists), so the reduced planes are a legal 4:2:0 frame of the smaller size. Device parity against the CPU oracle fed the CPU-reduced frame (same rule): five cases incl. odd 321x181 frames, N = 2/3/5, the owner's Mi-Log profile: 0 LSB, 0.0000% mismatch. Bench (random data, no grade chain, no window pass): 4K P010 to 1280x720 upload 4.12 + draw 2.88 = 7.0 ms per frame (60p budget 16.7 ms); 8K NV12 to 1280x720 upload 12.27 + draw 10.13 = 22.4 ms (30p budget 33.3 ms). Per the owner the preview rides this plane path, not OES; the plan records the integration steps (section 8). NativeSource gains the reduce argument and the bench door.
